backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window fixed protocol. Core baseline uses canonical snapshots; before reproduces the accepted exp-20260511-031 Space stack; after changes only the Space official-catalyst trend_long ATR target width.

gate_questions.acceptance_standard: Must improve aggregate EV/PnL versus exp031, improve at least 2/3 EV windows without EV regression versus exp031, stay EV-positive in all windows versus core, keep drawdown damage versus core <= 2 pp and versus exp031 <= 0.5 pp, and keep survival >= 5%.
gate_questions.alpha_hypothesis: exit: widen official-catalyst Space trend_long ATR targets.
prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260511-019 and exp-20260511-031 refined PL/BKSY breakout risk.
No prior Space experiment tested target-width exit convexity.
gate_questions.reproducibility: This script reruns core, exp031-equivalent before, and each Space target-width variant across the three fixed snapshots.
gate_questions.single_causal_variable: Official-catalyst Space trend_long target ATR multiple.

hypothesis: exit alpha: official-catalyst Space trend_long winners may be clipped by the shared regime target width; a wider ATR target could improve EV without adding noisy tickers or changing risk.
interpretation: Wider targets for official-catalyst Space trend entries improved the accepted default-off Space stack. Promotion must remain default-off metadata/helper only because live Space slots are zero.
known_risks: Target widening can convert quick target wins into later stops.
The Space candidate pool is still a static historical replay copy.
Any positive result must become a shared default-off helper before production exposure.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state soft-ranking still lacks enough closed forward decisions; this tests deterministic exit convexity.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby Space trend target widths on the same frozen windows; wait for forward Space trend replacement value or a genuinely new catalyst-quality field.
